_comment: Playwright MCP config. Uses system Edge (Chromium-family, channel=msedge) — installed, current, MS-network-native, and free of the Google GCM 'DEPRECATED_ENDPOINT' path that the managed system Chrome loops on. The ROOT-CAUSE fix is running this MCP under Node (see .mcp.json) instead of bun: bun 1.3.9 cannot drive Playwright's browser transport (pipe AND websocket both hang for every browser). Under Node, Edge/Chrome/bundled-chromium all launch in <700ms. Edge chosen over bundled chromium to avoid a flaky ~150MB download on the corporate network; switch to browserName=chromium (drop the channel) after `node <pkg>/cli.js install-browser chromium` completes if full policy-isolation is wanted. Diagnosis 2026-06-02 by 0.0.0_AB_MSTR.
